text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Five Red Army "heroes" are each jailed for three years.
- Unlicensed media may be "seized" while on-air.
- Crackdown on unregistered cars to boost state treasury revenue.
- Tax "short cuts" bad for business says minister of state for financial affairs.
- Syrian President Hafez al-Assad makes first visit to Iran in seven years.
- Information minister asks interior ministry to close two television stations and 23 radio stations.
- The price of gasoline increases by 400 Lebanese pounds and the price of kerosene and fuel oil by 200 pounds.
- Japanese Red Army members jailed for three years.
- Israel violates ceasefire agreement by shelling a village in southern Lebanon.
